svg.title: yak Dynamic Styles
svg.desc: A ToggleButton picks one of two css blocks from a prop. At build time, yak turns each block into a class in a CSS file, and the component works like a plain button that only switches its className. In the browser, a click only picks the other class.

g.text: yak builds every variant ahead of time
Each css branch becomes a class in a CSS file.
The prop only picks a class
No CSS is parsed or created in the browser.
